candidate.raw_translation: Kimanin kawai. The air-core siffar amfani Wheeler na daya-sahu kusanci da kuma shi ne wani jagora kauri lokacin da coil diamita ne mafi ƙaranci daga ZXQPH0000QXZ × winding tsawon. Shi omits waya kauri, tsawo, kusa metal, frequency, parasitic capacitance da kuma yanayin auna. Ga toroid, shigar da AL ma'auni daga sa daidai core datasheet; AL da permeability iya canzawa da frequency, zafi, DC bias, gap da masana'antu haƙuri. Tabbatar da duk wani gaskiya zane tare da core manufacturer da auna.
candidate.source: Estimate only. The air-core model uses Wheeler’s single-layer approximation and is a rough guide when coil diameter is less than 3× winding length. It omits wire thickness, spacing, nearby metal, frequency, parasitic capacitance and measurement conditions. For a toroid, enter the AL factor from its exact core datasheet; AL and permeability can change with frequency, temperature, DC bias, gap and manufacturing tolerance. Verify any real design with the core manufacturer and measurement.
